title: UI风格#242 - Watercolor Wash (水彩渲染)
description: 创建第242种UI风格：水彩渲染风格 - 水彩晕染、柔和色彩、艺术纸张。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planIJ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash style When color palette Then features soft pastels, wet bleed, paper texture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFB6C1 (浅粉), #87CEEB (天蓝), #98FB98 (苍绿), #DDA0DD (梅红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash style When typography Then uses artistic: Caveat, Dancing Script, Pacifico
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Caveat (手写), Dancing Script (流畅), Pacifico (艺术)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash style When layout Then organic edges, color bleed, wet-on-wet technique
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：有机边缘、色彩晕染、湿画技法

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash style When UI elements Then pigment flow, paper texture, brush strokes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：色素流动、纸张纹理、笔触效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash UI When functional Then includes blend chat, pigment agents, wash stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Watercolor Wash UI When copy Then uses artistic: 'Blend', 'Wash', 'Pigment', 'Stroke'
